translation.name: GOT WENG ABEM Alokso Abino Kalin

content: Am afung am dánono kal bada dubat dubatokabu sung uta ko.
Kale Yesus ayo Yol am bo bá kudá ei bom keimane alam weng kidimin kinim mak ayo dákadálaw, “Kukumin kinim kaba, kanomin tum dukum kidel kidel tuw am kidelok ginesiw. Be atamale! Akane,
Yesus ayo bakoyam, “kiba kanomin am dukum dukum bela utamiwe? Tum be mak ulum afadow dim mak bu ka, kalokabiw bá. Kale adikum bo dakela bakan abokabu ko.
Kale Yesus ayo mukkun auliw tikin Yol am mewso kal tein álano, Bita, Yemis, Yon, Andadu ilifin tad dákadá nadiwe bakodiw,
“kala, kaba bakoyam yaknámin atan kal kanodin kukuw bo kanam matam bokabu, yakalo! Ade yaknámin dubat dubatin kukuw uta kukuduno, nuka kal kei au, bo kanodongin keimu, kalokabuwe?” Akiwe,
beta Yesus ayo bakoyam, “kidela dufo bom nadiwo masi, kinim tad nadiwe aket takoyamodiw kala.
Kinim seng seng iyo nam win dim tade bom nadiwe kasen kei bakodokabiw ko. ‘Naka Walusa kinim’ namti, kalak bi ka. Yak bom nadiwe kinim wanang seng kibayo aket takoyamokabiw.
Kale kiba kidi bidiw wasi ginan matam bu, wasi bideng so keim matam bu namti, kanabuno kale banbin tabamin bá, kanamin kukuw usik matam benokabu. Kata kanabu umi atan kal afung am uyo dánomu banim.

Bakan mak kinim ita yak bakan mak kinim tabudiw ginan bidiw, kasák gu kasel mak ita yak kasák gu kasel mak tabudiw ginan bidiwe, yak anang madik madik bo bim dukum taba budu, imin wol fut matam bu keimokabu uyo wanang man daudono kale mámin yáw dákabu taw ko.

Kidela kibilimi ayo dufo bom nadiwo, kiba imadáliw yak abiw abiw kansol dim abiwe kawed am tem kaw tam kal fau bom keimokabiw uyo watawo kaleyo bá, nalam win tubudew káwin uta. Kale kiba gawman dukum dukum, kamok kamok imi kin dim tod nadiwe nam kin walamin keiyamokabiw kala.
Kaleyo Got weng ayo bakan kuw tabodu adikum kukuyam bidiwo,

kiba sakaw imadew faku nadiwe imadew tam kot keimin dim teibiw keimiw kaí, wataw wataw kalokabuwe, kal bom aket yamyamin bá, ulum bude tam kot dim tod bom aket fukanin mak bakodalo kaku namti, be kuw bakoyamin ka. Watawo kaleyo bá, be Got Sinik Abem alata kano bakodalo kakba kayo ko.
Muk sudon alata tabe muk atung dawo, wasi sikal ban dim teida anbidiw, fikalana bada alo alaw ayo alam man wasi keidaw bada, man tabe aulal wasi keiyam yanbidiw fikalan bidiw keimokabiw.

Kale adikum wanang kinim iyo kus kuw itamokabiw uyo watawo kaleyo bá, nam win tubudew tabamin uta ka. Kata kan kinim ata kitid fakadá bom todokaba ata kuw kano asada si am adik adik dánokaba kal kail bá takeikudawokaba.

Kale am dánámin mak tadokabu uyo ‘taltalin kukuw mafak mak kanam tadokabu. Kale kanodin kukuw mafak be abin abem kal tod budu utamokabiw. Kale yak kinim buk kímin kinim ayo dabadáliw bu ki kal keidane, yak Yuddia bakan wanang kinim itane wabading yak amguyo kal unin kala.
Kale yak kan ata am kudá abiw dal kal tein be kaí, aka tam am alam ufek ufek am bu uyo kudew unon kalin bá.
Kale yak kan kinim ata yong tein be namti, aka alo yak alam am gid ilim uyo kudew nadino kale unemin bá.
Kale kanam matam bokabu atan be yak wanang kumun sino so yak man muk wanin daw tad mikibu so ita ki atin fitokabiw kate!
Kiba Got bakada bidiwo kanodin kukuw mafak uyo gis am dánámin atan so kal tademin banim keidu kala.
Kale be watawo kaleyo bá, kanamin am dánámin atin mafak matam bokabu, be suwayo katow tein kudew tad bi kadák didu be kanodin kukuw so mak kanosu bá, ade yanol alo makso kanodokabu bá.

Kale Got aka kanodin am dánámin atin mafak bo mewtanonga kusa. Kale aka bo kanodongin banim nam, mew wanang kinim teinu mánu bo mak kanodin atan mafak bo bodiw banim. Kata alam wanang kinim walusa im luk beta kanodin am dánámin uyo mewtanonga kusa.
Kale kanam matam bune kabadákal kan kinim ata bakokam nada, ‘aye, kalak fen Walusa Kinim kaí, kalak abe’ kal bom, ‘meyak kabe tada’ kal bom keimiw namti, bo afano kalin bá.

Kale ibakanin walusa kinim so ibakanin lum senin kinim so iyo misuna bom nadiwe ika dubat dubatin kukuw so kudew matam dá bom nadiwe Go alam wanang kinim walusa iyo faltiyam imadew yak leiw mafak dádumo kale kanamokabiw, be ken leiw so keiyamano, beta kanamokabiw kala.
Kaleyo kiba kidela dufo bom nadiwo kale naka kama katow bu kal bakoyamsi.
Kata kanomin am mafak dánámin matam bokabu ki kanodokabu. Kale

content.text: ‘atan be midilokaba ade kayow be eidokaba bá.
Ade abid tikin milum bidi kadis mit abokabiw ade abid kuw tabodu be wok falil keidokabu.’

content: Kanabu um tem kabadákal wanang kinim iyo Got ami Kinim ayo ibin tem kitid so lamlam so kei madák aba atamokabiw ko.
Aka alam ensel imadála yak bakan maung maung so abid maung maung so alalew kal teidaw bom yak alam Kinim Walusa ki fabaduliw alam fukan unokabiw.
Kale kiba as yet umi kukuw kanamalu, be kidela utam kal keidin kala. Umi kon dudá malaw találu namti, nulum kal keidomo au, bo wok bang takam yum taba kaleyábuw.
Ulutaw kale kiba uta bidiw kanodin kukuw kukuw bakayabi uyo kanam matam bu kaí, beta kal keidomo nam tademin atan bo mew keibu ka. Kalin kala.
Naka atin dam weng bakoyamon, wanang kinim teinaliw kanam matam bokabu, ika fikalongin dako áliwo kanomin kukuw adikum bo adik wakadá kanodu utamokabiw.
Ade mew abid so bakan so kuw tabodu bo kalo banimokabu, kata nam weng adikum be banimomu banim.” Kale nadane

bako, ‘mew teinu mánu iyo mak kanodin am dánokabu uyo mak kal keidongin danim ade atan mak kal keidongin danim, abid tikin ensel iliso im kal banim ade alam Man so am kal keidongin banim, kata alam Alaw Got makuw alafin alam kal ko.
Kidela kin mo ade fasko bom nadiwo kala. Num kal banim yaknámin atan kal tadokabu.

Kalak alataw kale kinim mak alam am kudá bai anang mak unom nadale alam am so ufek ufek so uyo alam wok fakudawin kinim ‘kiwta kin modino, yake unom’ nadane alam wok fakudawin kinim iyo wok wak geleyam faku sidiwano yakei nadane kinim mak walu, ‘kawta awsom tod nam leiw fen sadawano.’ Akei unsa alataw,

kale kaba kidela dufo bom akalale kaunale kei bom leiw fen bom nadawo kala. Watawo kaleyo bá, am kayak ami tadokaba atan uyo kam kal banim. Kale kuina tadoma mak, midiliw tadoma mak, am fadena tadoma mak ade kutim tadoma mak kala.
Kale aka amonin kukam tadulomo kaba akál badaw ka. Kakoma kau ki kidela dufo bom nadawo kala.
Mew nam weng bakayabi. Beyo ki kinim wanang adikum kimi bakayabi, ‘kale kin mak kin bá bom nadiwo kala.’ Kalesa ko.
